info.title: agents-control
info.description: The methods the control plane answers itself, with no `h`. Every method's params are its one `params` value, sent as JSON-RPC's whole params (an object, or for a few a bare value), as DaemonAPI sends them. A method with `x-notification` has no result: the server sends it. The `web` tag marks what the web page calls and hears (DaemonAPI.WebSignatures); a method a Go step ports joins with its types, schema first.

x-declared-capabilities.name: client.wire/1
x-declared-capabilities.description: A client says its capabilities in ControlAuth on each connect, and reads -32008 as "update this app" (#1748). The control plane requires it of clients.

x-declared-capabilities.name: client.team/1
x-declared-capabilities.description: A client knows it belongs to one person of a team (#994, #1763). On a control plane with more than one person, the control plane answers a client without it -32074 updateToJoinTeam (R14).

x-declared-capabilities.name: machine/1
x-declared-capabilities.description: The control plane answers each host/* method as machine/* too, and a hosts/* method as machines/*, which machines/1 names (#2653). A step of the rename over three releases: the names in this document stay host/* and hosts/* until the senders move.

methods.name: attention/need
methods.description: A host, on its channel 0 (R6).

methods.name: attention/turn
methods.description: A host, on its channel 0 (#1744): a session's turn moved to a new phase.

methods.name: backups/commit
methods.description: A host, on its channel 0 (#1815): a backup's parts are all there; write its .json and keep the newest keep.

methods.name: backups/download
methods.description: A host, on its channel 0 (#1815): one part of a listed backup, for a restore.

methods.name: backups/stored
methods.description: A host, on its channel 0 (#1815): every backup of its owner's machines in the control plane's store, newest first.

methods.name: backups/upload
methods.description: A host, on its channel 0 (#1815): one part of a backup, in its own folder of the store.

methods.name: clients/announce
methods.description: On a pairing connection, before any other.

methods.name: clients/list
methods.description: devices/list, from a Remote of before the control plane, is answered the same; devices/startPairing as clients/startPairing, devices/forget with DeviceForget as clients/forget (daemon.openrpc.json has the host's own).

methods.name: clients/setActivityToken
methods.description: A device, over its own session (#1744): its Live Activity's push token for one session the activity speaks for (#2991), kept in its own client record, which only it may set. Refused from a window or a browser.

methods.name: clients/setGrant
methods.description: Retired with grants (#111): always refused, in words.

methods.name: clients/setPushToken
methods.description: A device, over its own session (#1460): its APNs token, kept in its own client record, which only it may set. Refused from a window or a browser.

methods.name: clients/setWebPush
methods.description: A browser, over its own session (#1486): its Web Push subscription, kept in its own client record, which only it may set. No endpoint takes it away. Refused from a phone, an iPad or a window, and when this control plane has no VAPID key.

methods.name: clients/webPushKey
methods.description: The control plane's VAPID public key (#1486), for a browser to subscribe with; none when it sends no Web Push.

methods.name: console/fleet
methods.description: Console ▸ Machines (#1804, M1): every machine, its owner and state. Admins only.

methods.name: console/live
methods.description: Console ▸ Live Now (#2019, M9): every agent running now on every machine, with its cost so far. Admins only.

methods.name: console/stopAgent
methods.description: Console ▸ Live Now (#2019, M9): an admin stops one agent on any machine. Admins only.

methods.name: console/teamWorkflows
methods.description: Console ▸ Team Workflows (#1804, M6): each bot, the workflows it ran and what runs now. Admins only.

methods.name: control/cutOff
methods.description: To every client of a person their org provider suspended (#1002, D13), then their sockets close with 4403 suspended.

methods.name: control/governanceRequested
methods.description: To admins (#2019, M5): a request for an MCP server or skill waits, or was decided.

methods.name: control/notice
methods.description: To admins (#1002): what changed with no click: the last admin kept, a SCIM group's shares left, a Remove request.

methods.name: control/orgRoutesChanged
methods.description: To every person's clients when an org route is added, changed or removed (#999).

methods.name: control/orgRoutesLeft
methods.description: To a removed machine's person and to every admin: the org routes it held (#999).

methods.name: control/ping
methods.description: A host, on its channel 0.

methods.name: control/policyChanged
methods.description: To every person's clients when the policy changes (#998).

methods.name: control/rotate
methods.description: An admin rotates the control plane's key (#997, spec 736 FR-043). Every member's connection is closed; each connects again with the previous key and is given the new one in ok. The previous key is accepted for 30 days. Refused on a control plane of several copies, or one whose key is handed in (AGENTS_CONTROL_KEY, --key-fd).

methods.name: control/signInDecided
methods.description: A waiting GitHub sign-in was approved, denied or ran out (#995).

methods.name: control/signInRequested
methods.description: A GitHub sign-in waits for this person's Approve (#995).

methods.name: control/signInWaiting
methods.description: On an `s:` connection: the sign-in waits for Approve, with the code to compare (#995).

methods.name: control/stopAll
methods.description: To every person's clients when the kill switch is turned on or off (#998), so a client draws the strip at once.

methods.name: folders/detect
methods.description: To a host just added, from a control plane before #656.

methods.name: folders/detected
methods.description: A host, on its channel 0 (#429): its answer to folders/detect.

methods.name: git/credential
methods.description: A host, on its channel 0, for its own git (#1122).

methods.name: governance/approvals
methods.description: An admin's (#2019, M5): every approval.

methods.name: governance/decide
methods.description: An admin's (#2019, M5): approve a request, for a group or the person, or refuse it.

methods.name: governance/report
methods.description: A host, on its channel 0 (#2019, M5): the MCP servers and skills it has from a catalogue.

methods.name: governance/request
methods.description: Anyone's (#2019, M5): ask for an MCP server or skill. Approved at once when a group of theirs, or they, already have it approved.

methods.name: governance/requests
methods.description: To an admin, the requests waiting; to anyone, their own (#2019, M5).

methods.name: governance/revoke
methods.description: An admin's (#2019, M5): take back an approval.

methods.name: governance/usage
methods.description: An admin's (#2019, M5): who uses each MCP server and skill, and at which version.

methods.name: groups/setRole
methods.description: An admin's (#1002, FR-020, FR-021): a SCIM group gives the admin role, or not. The roles of its members follow, never leaving no admin.

methods.name: handover/status
methods.description: On a copy's session (x:handover-…) only: what this copy says of itself (R16).

methods.name: host/clients
methods.description: To every host, on its channel 0, when it connects and when a window is paired or forgotten (#1118): the windows it may let in on its local socket.

methods.name: host/hello
methods.description: A host, on its channel 0, on every connect.

methods.name: host/machines
methods.description: A host, on its channel 0, for an agent there (#691 US6).

methods.name: host/orgRoutes
methods.description: To a machine that says host.org-routes/1, on its channel 0, at each join and within 5 seconds of a change to what it may use (#999, FR-005): every route its person may use, each secret sealed to the machine's key. A machine without it is sent nothing.

methods.name: host/orgRoutesAgain
methods.description: A machine, on its channel 0: a sealed route did not open; send its delivery again (#999).

methods.name: host/orgRoutesApplied
methods.description: A machine, on its channel 0, after it keeps a delivery of org routes (#999).

methods.name: host/policy
methods.description: To a machine that says host.policy/1, on its channel 0, at each join and within 5 seconds of each change (#998, FR-006). A machine says host.policy/1 only once it keeps and follows the policy; one without it is sent nothing.

methods.name: host/policyApplied
methods.description: A machine, on its channel 0, after it keeps a policy (#998).

methods.name: host/projects
methods.description: To a machine, on its channel 0, when a project its folders name changes its slots or name (#2669): the projects its folders name, with their slots.

methods.name: host/providerDraft
methods.description: A host, on its channel 0, for a writing agent there (#858).

methods.name: host/release
methods.description: To a machine that says host.update/1, on its channel 0, at each join: the release this control plane names, its own version, when that is a release (#2178). The machine updates Agents Host to it, if it is newer, between turns.

methods.name: host/status
methods.description: A host, on its channel 0 (#691 US4).

methods.name: host/user
methods.description: To a machine, on its channel 0, at each join and when its user changes (#1761): its user, their kind, its labels, and a bot's cap.

methods.name: host/userSettings
methods.description: To a machine that says host.user-settings/1, on its channel 0, at join and on each change (#1760): its user's settings and secrets.

methods.name: hosts/announce
methods.description: On an enrolment connection, before any other.

methods.name: hosts/update
methods.description: Update a server's host over ssh (#1766): its server and key given again, the host key checked as at an install, the server's root checked to be this host's, then the control plane's agentsd, MCP servers and toolsets copied and the host started again. The answer is an install's: {needsTrust, name} first for a key not yet trusted, then {updated: true, name}.

methods.name: links/check
methods.description: A machine, on its channel 0 (#1762, FR-037): may a channel message from this sender start work? Answers the linked person; an identity not linked asks its person to link it, and starts nothing.

methods.name: machines/forAgent
methods.description: Through host/machines only.

methods.name: machines/sendFolder
methods.description: Through host/machines only: one step of an agent's start_session with send (#2929), which sends this folder's branch to another of the person's machines, as Send to ‹machine›… does, or of its bring_back (#2947), which brings a branch back from there, as Bring Back from ‹machine›… does. The control plane sends that machine's folders/receiveState, folders/receiveUpload, folders/receive, folders/sendFacts, folders/sendPack or folders/sendRead; the machine has to be online.

methods.name: machines/sessionCall
methods.description: Through host/machines only (#2927): an agent's call on a session it started on another of the person's machines. The control plane sends that machine's agents/fromStarter, saying which machine and agent ask.

methods.name: machines/sessionEnded
methods.description: Through host/machines only (#2927): a session started from another machine ended. The control plane sends that machine's agents/endedElsewhere, naming this one; an offline one is not told, and finds out when it next asks.

methods.name: machines/startSession
methods.description: Through host/machines only (#2887): an agent's start_session on another of the person's machines. The id of the session it started; kept (-32067) when the machine is stopped and is starting.

methods.name: notices/delivered
methods.description: To the host whose notice it is, on its channel 0 (#2860): the control plane sent it to one of the person's devices, so the host records where on the notice's line.

methods.name: notices/take
methods.description: A host, on its channel 0 (#2859): may a notice go now? One bucket for the person, shared by every machine of theirs, with the limits the host has.

methods.name: orgRoutes/check
methods.description: An admin's: one small request from the control plane with the route's credential, where it can make one (#999).

methods.name: orgRoutes/list
methods.description: An admin's: every org route with its rev and how many machines hold it; no secret value (#999).

methods.name: orgRoutes/mine
methods.description: Any person's: the org routes they may use (#999).

methods.name: orgRoutes/remove
methods.description: An admin's: delete a route and its secrets, conditional on its rev; every machine that held it is sent its routes without it (#999).

methods.name: orgRoutes/replaceKey
methods.description: An admin's: new values for a route's secret fields, one version higher (#999).

methods.name: orgRoutes/set
methods.description: An admin's: add or change an org route, conditional on its rev; its secrets sealed with the keeper; audited and sent to the machines that may use it (#999).

methods.name: people/forViews
methods.description: Every person and bot on this control plane, with their forge logins and which is the caller (#2951), for the github, gitlab and linear servers' Team section and "An agent is on it". Open to a member as much as an admin.

methods.name: people/removeRequests
methods.description: An admin's (#1002, D13): the people an org provider deleted by SCIM, suspended and waiting for people/remove.

methods.name: people/setForgeLogins
methods.description: Sets the caller's own GitHub, GitLab and Linear logins (#2951), for Settings ▸ You, when they are not filled in from a machine's connection.

methods.name: policy/get
methods.description: An admin's: the whole policy, its rev, and each machine's applied version (#998).

methods.name: policy/mine
methods.description: Any person's: the policy in force (#998).

methods.name: policy/raise
methods.description: An admin's: raise a person's budget for today, UTC (#998, FR-019).

methods.name: policy/set
methods.description: An admin's: keep the rules, one version higher, signed, audited and sent to every machine (#998).

methods.name: policy/stopAll
methods.description: An admin's: the kill switch on or off (#998, FR-015).

methods.name: projects/joined
methods.description: A host, on its channel 0 (#2317): every folder it has and the project id each names. The control plane adopts the ids it does not know, and answers with those projects' slots (#2669).

methods.name: readApi/list
methods.description: An admin's (#2019): the read API's tokens and URL, and the OTLP exporter.

methods.name: readApi/make
methods.description: An admin's (#2019): a new read API token, its value shown once. At most 10 live.

methods.name: readApi/revoke
methods.description: An admin's (#2019): a read API token stops working at once.

methods.name: relay/count
methods.description: To a relay host, on its channel 0 (#1163).

methods.name: relay/deliver
methods.description: To a relay host, on its channel 0 (T097).

methods.name: relay/devices
methods.description: To a relay host, on its channel 0 (T096).

methods.name: relay/switch
methods.description: A relay host, on its channel 0 (#824).

methods.name: reports/deleteView
methods.description: Deletes one of the caller's saved views of Reports (#2019).

methods.name: reports/nodes
methods.description: The lineage nodes of one kind in a scope (#3118): issues, PRs, milestones or releases, with their cost, sessions and lead time, filtered, sorted and in pages of at most 100, from the machines' lineage nodes as reports/value reads them.

methods.name: reports/policy
methods.description: Who sees what in Reports (#1804). Admins only.

methods.name: reports/saveView
methods.description: Keeps a view of Reports for the caller (#2019): a new one with no id, or changes the one with its id. At most 50; a scope the caller may see.

methods.name: reports/scopes
methods.description: The scopes the caller may see in Reports (#1804).

methods.name: reports/setPolicy
methods.description: Changes who sees what in Reports (#1804): totals only, group leads and budgets. Admins only.

methods.name: reports/value
methods.description: What the work in a scope cost and delivered (#2351): cost per merged PR, per issue and per milestone, waste and lead time, from the machines' lineage nodes.

methods.name: reports/views
methods.description: The caller's saved views of Reports (#2019).

methods.name: scim/set
methods.description: An admin's (#1002, FR-013): SCIM on or off for an org provider, and its match attribute.

methods.name: scim/tokens/list
methods.description: An admin's (#1002, FR-014): a provider's SCIM tokens, with no value.

methods.name: scim/tokens/make
methods.description: An admin's (#1002, D12): a new SCIM token, its value shown once. Refused while two are live.

methods.name: scim/tokens/revoke
methods.description: An admin's (#1002, D12): the token stops working at once.

methods.name: signIn/addToMe
methods.description: Add a Google, Apple or GitHub sign-in to the caller's person (#995, FR-005): an ID token whose nonce is made from signIn/providers' challenge. Refused when it is another person's.

methods.name: signIn/approve
methods.description: Approve a waiting GitHub sign-in: the new client pairs as the caller's person (#995). A browser's needs the code it shows (#2097).

methods.name: signIn/ask
methods.description: On an `s:` connection only (#2097): a browser asks to pair as the person with this sign-in's email or GitHub login. It gets control/signInWaiting with a code, and is answered when the person types that code and approves on one of their clients. The same for an account nobody has: it waits, and nothing approves it.

methods.name: signIn/configure
methods.description: Admins (#995, FR-004, FR-006): turn a provider on or off, and allow Google Workspace domains or GitHub organisations.

methods.name: signIn/deny
methods.description: Deny a waiting GitHub sign-in (#995).

methods.name: signIn/discover
methods.description: On a sign-in or a paired connection (#1002, FR-011): the org provider an email's claimed domain sends people to.

methods.name: signIn/domains/check
methods.description: An admin's (#1002, D8): look for the domain's TXT record now.

methods.name: signIn/domains/claim
methods.description: An admin's (#1002, D8): claim a domain for one org provider; answers the TXT record to add. One domain has one provider.

methods.name: signIn/domains/list
methods.description: An admin's (#1002): every claimed domain.

methods.name: signIn/domains/preview
methods.description: An admin's (#1002, FR-012): who Require would refuse, before it is turned on.

methods.name: signIn/domains/remove
methods.description: An admin's (#1002): take a domain claim back.

methods.name: signIn/domains/set
methods.description: An admin's (#1002, D8, D9): turn Send people here and Require this provider on or off; either needs a proved domain.

methods.name: signIn/orgProviders/check
methods.description: An admin's (#1002, FR-004): read the issuer's discovery document and JWKS again, and say what is missing.

methods.name: signIn/orgProviders/list
methods.description: An admin's (#1002): every org provider, with no secret.

methods.name: signIn/orgProviders/remove
methods.description: An admin's (#1002, FR-009): remove an org provider and its sealed secret; its id is never used again.

methods.name: signIn/orgProviders/set
methods.description: An admin's (#1002, FR-001 to FR-004): add or change an org provider, conditional on its rev; its client secret sealed with the keeper. Refused -32082 orgProviderUnavailable with no keeper, no https address, or a discovery document that lacks the code flow with PKCE S256.

methods.name: signIn/orgStart
methods.description: On a sign-in or a paired connection (#1002, D2): the /v1/oidc/start address for an org provider's flow, bound to this connection.

methods.name: signIn/pair
methods.description: On an `s:` connection only (#995): sign in with Google or Apple (an ID token with the nonce) or GitHub (a user token), and pair as the person it names. A person not known joins only through an allowed Google Workspace domain; anyone else joins by an invite first. A GitHub sign-in waits for Approve on another client of the person (control/signInWaiting) before it is answered.

methods.name: signIn/providers
methods.description: The sign-in providers, and the challenge a client makes its nonce from on this connection (#995): on an `s:` connection before signIn/pair, or on a paired client's before signIn/addToMe.

methods.name: signIn/removeFromMe
methods.description: Take an outside sign-in off the caller's person (#995).

methods.name: signIn/requests
methods.description: The GitHub sign-ins waiting for the caller's Approve (#995, FR-010).

methods.name: signIn/ticket
methods.description: On the connection that started the flow (#1002, D3, FR-006): the ticket from the callback pairs it, or adds the sign-in to the caller's person. Used once, within 2 minutes. Refused -32077 orgSignInRequired, and when the provider's Who may join does not let a new person in.

methods.name: tunnel/open
methods.description: The borrowing host, on its channel 0 (T091).

methods.name: usage/rollup
methods.description: A host, on its channel 0 (#1811): its usage by the hour and the day.

methods.name: user/setAgentConfigFile
methods.description: A machine reports one local agent configuration file edit or deletion (#2129).

methods.name: user/setPolicy
methods.description: The keeper, on its channel 0 (#2957, research R11): your layer changed, so the part policy of your user settings takes it. The control plane checks the revision goes up, stores it unchanged, and pushes it (host/userSettings) to the person's machines that say host.policy-layers/1. Refused notKeeper when host is not the layer's own keeper.

methods.name: user/suspended
methods.description: To each machine of a suspended person, on its channel 0 (#1002, FR-018): at hello before its settings, and within 5 seconds of a change, on every copy. A machine without host.suspend/1 whose person is suspended is refused at hello -32078 personSuspended.

methods.name: workflows/claimRun
methods.description: A machine, on its channel 0 (#1761): asks to run a runs-on: workflow for one trigger; the first machine to ask runs it.

methods.name: workflows/fire
methods.description: To a bot's machine, on its channel 0, which only the control plane writes (#2011, FR-035): run a runs-on: workflow for a trigger the control plane took once.

methods.name: workflows/trigger
methods.description: A machine, on its channel 0 (#2011, FR-035): a server's event or a schedule matched a runs-on: workflow. When runs-on: names a bot, the control plane sends it once, to one of the bot's machines (workflows/fire).
